Who We Are

A Delhi-Based Manufacturer Trusted by Garment Buyers Since 1977

Jai Baba Nanak Cloth Trading Co. began as a small cloth trading business in Delhi in 1977 and has grown into a trusted manufacturer of premium interlining fabrics. With decades of experience, we supply buckram, fusible interlining, pocketing cloth, collar & cuff, belt roll & placket, shoulder pads, EVA foam, woven & knitted elastics, tatron, velcro tape and other garment accessories to manufacturers, wholesalers, buying houses, and exporters.

As a family-run business now led by the next generation, we remain committed to consistent quality, reliable supply, and direct manufacturer pricing—ensuring every order meets the standards our customers expect.

blocks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
blocks.intro: Can't find your answer here? Send it to us directly and we'll respond within one business day.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity for bulk enquiries?
items.a: Minimum quantities vary by product category and roll width. Share your requirement through our contact form and we'll confirm feasible order sizes along with lead time for your specific fabric.

items.q: Can you supply custom widths or GSM specifications?
items.a: Yes. We regularly produce to buyer-specified width, weight and stiffness within our manufacturing capability. Send your specification sheet and we'll confirm what we can match.
Yes, we supply to export buyers and buying houses with full documentation and container-ready packing. See our Exports page for more detail on our process.

items.q: How do I request fabric samples before placing a bulk order?
items.a: Contact us with your product category and application. We can arrange samples for evaluation before you commit to a bulk production order.

items.q: What is your typical lead time for bulk orders?
items.a: Lead time depends on product category, quantity and current production schedule. We confirm a firm delivery date at the time of order confirmation, not after.

blocks.heading: Ready To Discuss Your Next Bulk Order?
blocks.text: Tell us your product, quantity and timeline — our team will respond with pricing and lead time within one business day.
